data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 游轮甲板的灿金比基尼回眸
data.description: 巡航于热带蔚蓝海域的皇家游轮私人阳光甲板上，海风吹拂着白帆。拉·芙利亚身穿华丽耀眼的金色系带比基尼倚在木质甲板护栏旁。银白长发在阳光下散发着钻石般的璀璨光华，无可挑剔的皇女身段在海天一色间尽情舒展。她微微侧过脸颊回首轻笑，祖母绿眼眸中尽是高贵从容与撩人心弦的调皮神色。
data.action: leaning against teak ship railing in metallic gold bikini, silver hair fluttering in sea breeze, sparkling ocean background, playful aristocratic wink and smile
data.location: private sun deck of luxury cruise ship with panoramic ocean views
data.lighting: brilliant tropical sunlight glistening on azure water and gold bikini fabric
data.mood: dazzling royal glamour, playful commanding seduction
data.promptProse: Leaning on the polished teak railing of a luxury cruise ship, La Folia dazzles in a shimmering gold bikini. The ocean wind whips her long silver hair as she glances over her shoulder with an enchanting, aristocratic smile.
data.animaCaption: La Folia standing on a cruise ship deck in a gold bikini, smiling with silver hair in the wind.
